authoring: New synthetic records, documents and individually specified business objectives; no Agent-derived Gold
postgresql_preparation: Read-only real MCP queries over bounded literal VALUES CTEs only; no physical business relations, INSERT, DDL, seed or Registry writes
dataset_catalog_state: planned_not_registered; UUID/version/source/confirmation/definition hashes frozen before seal; later materialization must match exactly
rag_catalog_state: planned_not_indexed; exact Target/ModelSpec/chunker/source/chunk/index hashes frozen; no Holdout query retrieval before Live authorization
numeric_gold: Independent CSV/XLSX records + Python Decimal/set operations, cross-checked with independently formulated PostgreSQL SELECT/VALUES through original MCP
document_gold: Author-specified fact spans, source versions and allowed citation groups; independent of retrieval rankings, similarity thresholds and Agent completion
confirmation: Synthetic authoring definitions are proposals; actual Registry confirmation and host approval must be separately reviewed before future Live

scoring.business_denominator: All 60 planned tasks, including legitimate unavailable/blocked outcomes and not_run; also report 20-task lane denominators
scoring.successful_execution: Observed original terminal runtime status, separate from business correctness
scoring.business_correctness: Every required goal has exact independently specified value/unit/window and original P3 six-layer verified refs, or the predeclared refusal/missing-evidence outcome; no extra false claim
scoring.numeric_denominator: Every expected numeric goal; exact Decimal equality including numerator/denominator where defined
scoring.reference_denominator: All published references and all required source groups, separately; validate original P3/RAG provenance through trusted read-only collection
scoring.causal_boundary: Descriptive/temporal association never proves causality; retain verified metrics while explicitly withholding unsupported causal claims
scoring.confidence: 95% Wilson with numerator/denominator; zero denominator is null

leakage_checks.numeric_normalization: replace digit runs with #, normalize whitespace/case

future_live_envelope.entry_track: Explicitly user-reviewed ReportScope to original Durable/Gateway/LangGraph/MCP/Verifier/Report; not an unimplemented Chat-first semantic integration

stop_boundary: Seal preparation artifacts, report remaining gates, stop; no Live business evaluation, Gate 3, active Agent, commit or push
